items.finding: Water OH bands exhibit substantial temperature sensitivity in NIR and MIR measurements of aqueous systems, requiring temperature-controlled sample holders.
items.how_it_applies: Because temperature changes distort water absorption bands in aqueous streams, tracking stream temperature with an auxiliary sensor such as an RTD could be critical for compensation. The team should evaluate how temperature shifts in the whey process affect NIR spectral features and model stability.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The cited review addresses biopharmaceutical downstream processing rather than dairy whey streams, and it mentions tempered sample holders rather than in-line RTD probe integration.

citation.quote: Additionally, the temperature sensitivity of the OH bands is a severe drawback for measuring aqueous solution in NIR and MIR, which makes tempered sample holders necessary [29].
